S.FORM: alang Sagaran ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Santimon go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 195 buwan, 698 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 662 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 36 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 89%, Rukay 2%, Bunun 1%, Amis 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Sagaran hya' ga Valjulu. tay mkyahu' na Sagaran hya' ga Tjailjaking. tay 'llaw na Sagaran hya' ga Tjukuvulj. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [s|ɕ]aɣaran ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu [s|ɕ]antimon ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** rukaj * βunun * ami[s|ɕ] * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na [s|ɕ]aɣaran ħjaʔ ɣa *aljulu taj mkjaħuʔ na [s|ɕ]aɣaran ħjaʔ ɣa tjailjakiŋ taj ʔllaw na [s|ɕ]aɣaran ħjaʔ ɣa tjuku*ulj reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
